items.label: la face
items.scene: A toddler makes a big FUSS ("FAHS") in front of the mirror, scrunching her FACE up like a prune.

items.label: la peau
items.scene: A dermatologist checks a boy's SKIN with a magnifying glass while he peels a POtato ("POH"), its SKIN curling off in one long ribbon.

items.label: la joue
items.scene: A ZOO ("ZHOO") keeper in khaki gets a big kiss on the CHEEK from a baby elephant's trunk, and the cheek glows pink.

items.label: la figure
items.scene: A FIGURE skater ("fee-GEWR") twirls and admires her own beaming FACE in the big mirror.

items.label: le visage
items.scene: A border guard holds up a traveller's VISA ("vee-ZAHZH") and compares the photo with his FACE, nose to nose.

items.label: le cheveu
items.scene: A uniformed attendant points a buzzing SHAVER ("shuh-VEUH") at the ONE single HAIR on top of a giant boiled egg on a stand.

items.label: l'œil
items.scene: A sailor boy shouts "AHOY!" ("UHY") as he peers through a brass spyglass with one EYE, the other screwed shut.

items.label: le poil
items.scene: A furry little creature clings to a WALL ("PWAHL"), its HAIR all fluffed up.
